original_content_full:
The paper "Controlling Geometric Abstraction and Texture for Artistic Images" by Martin Büßemeyer, Max Reimann, Benito Buchheim, Amir Semmo, Jürgen Döllner, and Matthias Trapp was 
accepted for publication at the 22th International Conference on Cyberworlds (CW2023). The conference will take place in Sousse, Tunesia from October 3rd to 5th. The paper and code are available here. For more information, visit the website.
